description: React component for managing system roles in Mattermost admin console, including permissions and user assignments.

classes.name: SystemRole
classes.description: React component class for editing system roles, permissions, and associated users.

methods.name: getSaveStateNeeded
methods.description: Determines if there are unsaved changes based on current and next state.

methods.name: addUsersToRole
methods.description: Adds selected users to the role, updating state and navigation blocking.

methods.name: removeUserFromRole
methods.description: Removes a user from the role, updating state and navigation blocking.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Saves role permission changes and user role updates to the server.

methods.name: updatePermissions
methods.description: Updates permissions for the role and manages related state.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the role management UI including permissions, users, and save panel.
